# Security Policy

**PLEASE DON'T DISCLOSE SECURITY-RELATED ISSUES PUBLICLY, [SEE BELOW](#reporting-a-vulnerability).**

## Supported Versions

| Version       | Supported |
| ------------- | --------- |
| 7.x           | Yes       |
| 6.x and below | No        |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

The preferred way to report a security vulnerability is GitHub private vulnerability reporting. Open this repository's [Security](https://github.com/austintoddj/canvas/security) tab, then choose **Report a vulnerability** (https://github.com/austintoddj/canvas/security/advisories/new).

You can also email Todd Austin at austin.todd.j@gmail.com. All security vulnerabilities will be promptly addressed.
